items.action: Ab is item ka export na karein. Export plan bana rahe hain to update karein.

items.headline: Stand-Up India scheme ab aur aage continue hoga

items.action: Import me correct CTH use karein, exemption claim mat karein.

items.action: GST compliance calendar update karein. Rate change ki planning ab 1 April ko hi consider karein.

items.headline: GST 2.0 launch: Registration aur refund process ab easy
items.what: GST Council ne GST 2.0 launch kiya hai. Ismein registration aur refund process ko aur bhi smooth banaya gaya hai.
items.who: Sab CGST registered businesses aur new applicants.
items.action: Naye registration aur refund ke processes ko GST portal par check karein. Updated guidelines follow karein.

items.headline: GST Council: 17 din me refund, easier ITC, registrations
items.what: GST Council naye reforms lane wala hai jaise 17 din me GST refunds, simplified registrations, aur input tax credit ko aasan banana agenda par hai.
items.who: GST registered businesses, tax professionals.
items.action: GST portal par updates aur new processes par nazar banayein. Refund filing process par focus karein.

items.headline: Playground aur gym equipment par alag GST rates
items.what: Gujarat AAR ne rule diya: outdoor playground equipment par 5% GST, gym equipment par 18% GST lagega. Bearings HSN 8482 mein aate hain.
items.who: Gujarat ke playground, gym equipment suppliers aur buyers.
items.action: GST invoices mein sahi rate lagayen. Billing karte waqt HSN code confirm karein.

items.headline: Haryana OTS scheme deadline ab 30 Nov 2026
items.what: Haryana ne One-Time Settlement Scheme, 2026 ki deadline 30 November 2026 tak badha di hai. Scheme mein dues settle kiye ja sakte hain.
items.who: Haryana ke taxpayers jinpar pending dues hain.
items.action: OTS scheme ka benefit lene ke liye 30 Nov 2026 tak apply karein. Portal ya office se process dekhein.

items.headline: Punjab: Industrial land leasehold to freehold at 5% fee
items.what: Punjab sarkar ne leasehold industrial land ko freehold convert karne ko approval de diya hai, 5% fee ke saath.
items.who: Punjab ke industrial land holders jo conversion chahte hain.
items.action: Agar aapke paas leasehold industrial plot hai, to 5% fee ke saath freehold conversion ke liye apply karein.

items.headline: GST Council meet 8 Oct, focus input credit relax on vehicles
items.what: GST Council ki meeting 8 October ko hai. Proposals mein 13 seater tak vehicles par input tax credit ki pabandiyan aasaan karne ki baat uthi hai.
items.who: Business jo aise vehicles kharidte ya istemal karte hain.
items.action: 8 October ki meeting ke faisle ka intezar karein, fir vehicle purchase planning karein.

items.headline: GST Council meeting ab 8 October, reschedule hua
items.what: 57th GST Council meeting ab 8 October 2026 ko Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi me hogi. Pehle scheduled date badli gayi hai.
items.who: GST professionals, CAs, businesses sab affected hain.
items.action: Naye date ki meeting ke faislon ka wait karein; GST compliance updates check karein.

items.headline: Playground equip par 5% GST, gym equip par 18%
items.what: Gujarat AAR ne outdoor playground equipment aur parts par 5% GST aur outdoor gym equipment plus parts par 18% GST lagu decide kiya hai. Bearings HSN 8482 mein include kiye gaye hain.
items.who: Dealers, manufacturers jo aisa maal bechte hain ya kharidte hain.
items.action: GST billing mein sahi rate ka istemal karein products ke hisaab se; HSN code bhi dhyan mein rakhein.

items.headline: Delhi EV Policy 2026: 5,600+ applications, Rs 4.8 cr incentives
items.what: Delhi ki EV Policy 2026 ke tahat ab tak 5,600 se zyada applications mili hain aur 4.8 crore rupaye incentives release ho chuke hain.
items.who: Delhi mein electric vehicle kharidne wale buyers aur businesses.
items.action: Agar EV lene ka plan hai to policy aur incentives check karein; apply karein to benefit lein.

items.headline: Haryana One-Time Settlement Scheme deadline ab 30 Nov 2026
items.what: Haryana ne One-Time Settlement Scheme 2026 ki deadline extend karke 30 November 2026 kar di hai.
items.who: Haryana ke taxpayers, traders aur businesses jin par scheme lagu ho sakti hai.
items.action: Jo settlement scheme me aana chahte hain, process complete karein deadline se pehle.

items.headline: J&K Common Duct Policy 2026 notified
items.what: Jammu & Kashmir sarkar ne Common Duct Policy 2026 notify ki, taaki baar-baar road khod ke utility lines bichane ki zarurat na pade.
items.who: Utility companies, contractors, infra businesses J&K mein.
items.action: Nayi policy padhein aur line laying projects plan karte waqt policy ka palan karein.

items.headline: Garbage tax clearance ab property transaction se linked
items.what: Punjab sarkar ne kachra tax (garbage tax) ki clearance ko property transactions se jod diya hai. Ab property bechne-kharidne se pehle yeh tax clear karna hoga.
items.who: Punjab mein property buy/sell karne wale individuals aur businesses.
items.action: Property deal karne se pehle garbage tax ka payment check karein aur clear karein.

items.headline: Tax Audit Due Date ab 21 Oct 2026, ITR ke liye bhi extension
items.what: CBDT ne Tax Audit ki last date ab 21 October 2026 tak bada di hai. ITR ki due date bhi ab 21 November 2026 hai.
items.who: Woh taxpayers jin par audit mandatory hai under Income Tax Act.
items.action: Agar aapka audit lagta hai, to 21 October 2026 tak audit report file karein, aur ITR 21 November tak file karein.

items.headline: 12% reservation for Agniveers in Assam Police, SDRF, Fire
items.what: Assam Cabinet ne Police, SDRF aur Fire Services mein Agniveers ke liye 12% reservation approve kiya hai.
items.who: Sirf Agniveer scheme ke zariye recruit hone wale candidates.
items.action: Agniveers jo in posts ke liye apply karna chahte hain, reservation ka benefit check karein.

items.headline: Haryana ne industrial regularisation policy amend ki
items.what: Haryana sarkar ne policy modify ki hai taki industrial areas mein municipal limits ke bahar bhi civic amenities provide ki ja sakein.
items.who: Haryana ke un industrial units par asar jo municipal limits ke bahar hain.
items.action: Industrial units ko nayi policy ki details padhkar compliance ya benefit ka plan banana chahiye.

items.headline: J&K released Compressed Bio-Gas Policy 2026
items.what: Jammu and Kashmir ne waste se fuel banane ke liye CBG policy notify ki hai.
items.who: Waste management, renewable energy aur gas production sector ke stakeholders ke liye.
items.action: Interested businesses aur investors CBG policy ke rules aur incentives ko study karein.

items.headline: Gujarat: Vehicle scrapping par 50% tax concession
items.what: Gujarat government ne vehicle scrapping scheme mein 50% vehicle tax concession approve kiya hai.
items.who: Gujarat ke vehicle owners jo apni purani gaadi scrap karte hain.
items.action: Vehicle scrap karte waqt concession ke liye scheme ki eligibility conditions check karein.

items.headline: Bihar ne regional airports par ATF VAT zero kiya
items.what: Bihar sarkar ne regional airports par Aviation Turbine Fuel (ATF) par VAT ko zero kar diya hai UDAN scheme ke andar connectivity badhane ke liye.
items.who: Airlines jo Bihar ke regional airports se operate karti hain.
items.action: UDAN scheme ya regional airport se udan chalane wale airlines VAT exemption ka benefit le sakte hain.

items.headline: Gujarat UCC Bill ko President ka assent, lagu tab jab state notify karega
items.what: Gujarat Uniform Civil Code (UCC) Bill ko President ki manzoori mil gayi hai, implementation state notification ke baad hoga.
items.who: Gujarat ke sabhi nagrik, family law changes honge jab notification aaye.
items.action: Legal, business aur HR teams UCC notification ka intezar karein, implementation ke baad hi rules applicable honge.

items.headline: GST Council 7 Oct ko refunds aur registration par focus karega
items.what: GST Council ki meeting 7 October ko hai jisme refunds aur GST registration reforms cover honge.
items.who: Sabhi taxpayers aur e-commerce sellers jinhe GST registration/exemption chahiye ya refund claim process me interest hai.
items.action: Taxpayers latest council decisions ki updates follow karein, registration aur refund process par impact ho sakta hai.

items.headline: MSME aur Statistics Ministry ne Statistical Business Register majboot kiya
items.what: MSME Ministry aur Statistics Ministry ne milkar Statistical Business Register ko mazboot karne ke liye agreement sign kiya hai.
items.who: Business owners, MSMEs, aur data providers is register mein shamil honge.
items.action: Business related statistics update karne mein interested stakeholders latest process ka palan karein.

items.headline: Gujarat Industrial Policy 2026: Manufacturing aur startups par focus
items.what: Gujarat sarkar ne nayi Industrial Policy 2026 jari ki hai, jisme manufacturing aur startup sector ko prathmikta di gayi hai.
items.who: Gujarat ke manufacturers, startups aur investors par lagu.
items.action: Manufacturing ya startup plans hai to nayi policy ke provisions dekhein, eligibility aur benefits samjhein.

items.headline: J&K ne Compressed Bio-Gas (CBG) Policy 2026 notify ki
items.what: Jammu & Kashmir sarkar ne kachre se fuel banane ke liye Compressed Bio-Gas (CBG) Policy 2026 notify ki hai.
items.who: Waste management businesses, biogas producers aur related investors J&K mein.
items.action: CBG projects mein interested log nayi policy dekhein aur process samjhein.

items.headline: Tamil Nadu: Shops ko 365 din khula rakhne ki permission extend
items.what: Tamil Nadu ne dukaane aur establishments ko 365 din khula rakhne ki permission extend ki hai, kuch employee suraksha conditions ke saath.
items.who: Tamil Nadu ke sabhi shop aur business owners jin ki establishments mein log kaam karte hain.
items.action: Jo shops din bhar kholte hain, naye employee safeguard rules padhein aur implement karein.

items.headline: Gujarat: Vehicle scrap par 50% vehicle tax concession approve
items.what: Gujarat sarkar ne purane vehicles scrap karne par vehicle tax mein 50% chhoot approve ki hai.
items.who: Gujarat ke vehicle owners jo gaadi scrap karne ki soch rahe hain.
items.action: Agar vehicle scrap plan hai to sarkari concession rules dekhein, apply karen.

items.headline: Bihar: Regional airports par ATF VAT zero kiya UDAN scheme ke liye
items.what: Bihar sarkar ne regional airports par Aviation Turbine Fuel (ATF) par VAT zero kiya hai, taki sampark badhe.
items.who: Aviation companies jo Bihar ke regional airports se udan chala rahe hain.
items.action: Regulatory aur costing changes ko consideration mein lein, operations adjust karen.

items.headline: Liquor shop application ki deadline ab 6 October hai Andhra Pradesh mein
items.what: Andhra Pradesh mein liquor shop ke liye application ki deadline extend kar ke 6 October tak kar di gayi hai.
items.who: Andhra Pradesh mein liquor shops kholne ke liye apply karne wale business owners.
items.action: Agar abhi tak apply nahi kiya hai to 6 October tak zarur application jama kar dein.

items.headline: ITR aur audit report filing date badhi
items.what: CBDT ne ITR aur audit report file karne ki deadline extend ki hai for AY 2026-27. Official circular jaari hua hai.
items.who: Sab taxpayers jinko income tax return ya audit report file karna hai AY 2026-27 ke liye.
items.action: Nayi deadline ke hisaab se ITR aur audit report file karo. Circular padho aur apne CA se salah lo.

items.headline: RoDTEP scheme ab 31 Dec 2026 tak
items.what: RoDTEP export tax refund scheme ki validity ko badha diya gaya hai till 31 December 2026. Rates mein koi change nahi hai.
items.who: Sab exporters jo RoDTEP ke benefit lete hain.
items.action: 31 Dec 2026 tak RoDTEP ka benefit claim karna jaari rakhein. Current rates check karlein.

items.headline: EPF wage ceiling badha, salary cut allowed nahi
items.what: EPF wage ceiling ab Rs 15,000 se badh kar Rs 25,000 ho gayi hai. Ministry ne employers ko salary cut na karne ke liye direct kiya hai.
items.who: Sab employers aur employees jin par EPF lagu hota hai.
items.action: Employers apne employees ki salary cut na karein. Naye wage ceiling ke hisaab se EPF calculation revise karein.

items.headline: NFRA ne auditors ke liye SA 570 guidance jaari ki
items.what: NFRA ne auditors aur audit committees ko 'going concern' ke evaluation par guidance diya hai SA 570 ke under. Reporting aur CARO 2020 requirements bhi clarify kiye gaye.
items.who: Sab company auditors aur audit committees jinko SA 570 apply hota hai.
items.action: Auditors aur audit committee members ko NFRA ki guidance detail mein padhni hogi aur apne audit process ko usi ke hisaab se align karna hoga.

items.headline: GSTN: Ab ek PAN se multiple states mein registration
items.what: GSTN ne Multistate Registration facility launch ki hai. Isse taxpayers ab ek PAN par multiple states/UTs mein GST registration apply kar sakte hain.
items.who: Sab normal GST taxpayers jo alag-alag states/UTs mein business karte hain.
items.action: Agar aapko kai states mein business karna hai to ab ek saath multiple registrations apply karo ek PAN ke under, GST portal par jaakar.

items.headline: Gujarat: Vehicle scrap par 50% vehicle tax concession
items.what: Gujarat sarkar ne vehicle scrapping par 50% vehicle tax concession approve kar diya hai. Yaani purane gaadi scrap karne par tax mein chhoot milegi.
items.who: Sab vehicle owners Gujarat mein jo purane vehicle scrap karna chahte hain.
items.action: Vehicle scrap karne ki soch rahe hain to ab 50% tax concession ka benefit le sakte hain. Official process follow karein.

items.headline: J&K ne Compressed Bio-Gas Policy 2026 notify ki
items.what: Jammu and Kashmir government ne Compressed Bio-Gas (CBG) Policy 2026 notify ki hai. Ab kachre se fuel banane ki policy aa gayi hai.
items.who: Sab businesses aur units J&K mein jo CBG ya waste-to-fuel projects mein interested hain.
items.action: CBG plant lagane ya invest karne ki planning hai to policy ki full details J&K Govt notification se padhein.

items.headline: September 2026 GST revenue crosses Rs 2 lakh crore
items.what: September 2026 mein gross GST revenue 14.7% badh kar Rs 2,03,521 crore ho gaya. Net GST revenue bhi 18.1% upar gaya.
items.who: Sab GST registered businesses par lagu.
items.action: September GST collection aur return filing ki details sahi se verify karein.

items.headline: Revised Customs Tariff Values effective 1st Oct 2026
items.what: CBIC ne palm oil, soybean oil, brass scrap, gold, silver, aur areca nut ke liye tariff values revise ki hai. Ye Notification No. 80/2026-Customs (N.T.) ke tahat hai.
items.who: Importers dealing with listed goods.
items.action: 1 October 2026 se naye tariff values ko import calculations mein include karein.

items.headline: Import permit mandatory for non-insecticidal insecticide imports
items.what: CBIC ne Insecticides Rules, 1971 amend kiye hain. Non-insecticidal use ke liye import hone wale insecticides (jaise acrylonitrile) par ab import permit compulsory hai.
items.who: Sab importers jo insecticides non-insecticidal purpose ke liye import karte hain.
items.action: Import se pehle specified insecticides ke liye permit hasil karein.

items.headline: J&K notifies Electric Vehicle Policy 2026
items.what: Jammu and Kashmir sarkar ne Electric Vehicle Policy 2026 notify kari hai. Nayi policy electric mobility ko promote karti hai.
items.who: J&K ke auto, logistics sector, EV manufacturers, aur businesses.
items.action: Nayi policy ke incentive aur compliance points ko study karein agar EV segment mein kaam karte hain.

items.authority: Union Minister of Petroleum and Natural Gas
items.headline: GOBARdhan Scheme launch for Compressed Biogas sector
items.what: Union Minister ne GOBARdhan Scheme ko launch kiya hai. Scheme ka maksat India ke Compressed Biogas sector ko boost karna hai.
items.who: Biogas producers, waste management businesses aur allied MSMEs ke liye.
items.action: Scheme ke guidelines aur application procedure ko dekhein agar biogas sector mein kaam karte hain.

items.headline: Secretarial Standards SS-1, SS-2: Minutes compliance guide
items.what: Company meetings ke liye Secretarial Standards SS-1 (Board meetings) aur SS-2 (General meetings) ka follow hona zaruri. Inmein drafting, signing, preservation aur timelines ka process diya hai.
items.who: All companies incorporated under Companies Act, 2013.
items.action: Meetings ki minutes banate waqt SS-1 aur SS-2 standards ko strictly follow karein.

items.headline: Kitchen exhaust hoods 120 cm+ under CTH 8414 80 90
items.what: CAAR Mumbai ka kehna hai ki 120 cm se bade kitchen exhaust hoods with Capture Jet fan ab CTH 8414 80 90 me classifiable hai, CTH 8414 59 90 nahi.
items.who: Importers of big kitchen exhaust hoods with Capture Jet fan.
items.action: Import classification aur customs paperwork mein sahi HSN use karein.

items.headline: Delhi MSME Conclave mein local business support pe zor
items.what: Delhi government ne MSME Conclave organize kiya. Conclave ne local enterprises ke support pe highlight diya hai.
items.who: Delhi ki MSMEs aur startups ke liye.
items.action: Conclave ke recommendations aur support schemes ka fayda lene ke liye government websites check karein.

items.headline: Karnataka GST collection Rs 2.04 lakh crore, 14.7% growth
items.what: Karnataka mein September 2026 GST collection 14.7% badha, total Rs 2.04 lakh crore hua.
items.who: Karnataka ke GST registered businesses.
items.action: Monthly GST return ki filing timely karein, increased compliance focus rakhein.

items.headline: CBDT ne audit cases ke liye I-T return ki last date badhai
items.what: CBDT ne audit cases ki income tax return file karne ki deadline extend kar di hai. Ab naye date pe file kar sakte hain.
items.who: Jinke cases audit me aate hain, un businesses, professionals par lagu.
items.action: Aap audit cases ki return ab extended last date tak file kar sakte hain.

items.headline: India ne sugar export par turant ban lagaya, Sept 2026 tak
items.what: Bharat sarkar ne sugar ki export par abhi se turant pratibandh laga diya hai. Yeh ban September 2026 tak rahega.
items.who: Sugar exporters, exporters associations par asar.
items.action: Sugar export ab turant band kar dein. Koi bhi naya export shipment book na karein.

items.headline: RoDTEP scheme exporters ke liye 3 mahine badha
items.what: Centre ne RoDTEP (export incentive scheme) ki validity ab 31 December 2026 tak badha di hai. Exporters ko aur 3 mahine ka samay mil gaya hai.
items.who: All eligible Indian exporters jinke products RoDTEP mein aate hain.
items.action: RoDTEP ke tahat apna claim ab 31 Dec tak file karen. Scheme ki extended period ko dhyan mein rakhen.

items.headline: RoSCTL scheme for apparel export 3 mahine extend
items.what: Kapda aur made-up goods export par milne wali RoSCTL scheme ki validity 3 mahine badh gayi hai. Ab aur time milega incentive claim karne ka.
items.who: Apparel aur made-up goods exporters ko pratyaksh benefit.
items.action: RoSCTL scheme under incentive ab 3 mahine aur claim karein. Extended duration ka use karen.

items.headline: Green Energy Corridor scheme ko Cabinet ki manzoori mili
items.what: Rs 1.86 lakh crore Green Energy Corridor scheme ko Cabinet ka approval mil gaya hai. Iska focus renewable energy par hai.
items.who: Renewable energy sector, companies jo energy transmission mein judi hain.
items.action: Scheme ki guidelines aur incentives ka intezar karein. Planning mein is scheme ko consider karein.

items.headline: MSP par soybean, moong, tur ki kharid manzoor 3 states mein
items.what: Sarkar ne soybean, moong aur tur ki kharid MSP par approve ki hai. Total 7.11 lakh tonne procurement hogi teen rajyon mein.
items.who: Farmers of 3 specified states jahan procurement hoga.
items.action: Agar aap eligible farmer hain, to MSP par bechne ka mauka milega. Details ka intezar karein.

items.headline: 57th GST Council Meeting: Registration, ITC, Process reforms
items.what: GST Council ki 57th meeting mein registration process, input tax credit (ITC) rules, Section 17(5), invoice mismatches par kuch reforms discuss honge.
items.who: GST registered businesses, professionals aur tax practitioners.
items.action: Jo bhi naye updates circulars nikle, uske hisaab se apni compliance aur accounting practice update karein.
